limitations: This is an isolated proposal; canonical authority, RULE_HASH, and selected production generate() remain the original left-expansion task.
Evidence covers two deterministic four-pair episodes and the opposite-side rival, not every seed or every conceivable alternative rule.
The side is intentionally visible in every demonstration; this validates coherent episode-level parameterization rather than difficult latent-rule inference.

parameter.input_constraints: Every active winner has an empty, in-bounds adjacent column on both sides; same-setting expanded rectangles of distinct colors do not overlap. The selected generator's object roles, component selection, erasure, bbox fill, palette, and schedule are unchanged.
parameter.name: expansion_side

semantics.left: after selecting the largest component (canonical tie-break), fill its bounding rectangle plus one column on the left
semantics.right: after the same selection, fill its bounding rectangle plus one column on the right
